wind.constraints: stock only; statements=[metrics]; at most one explicit report period

allowed_equivalents: records with explicit disclosure date, report period, CNY values and percent changes under the exact runtime mapping
fallback_gate: Wind financials alone lacks disclosure date and同比/环比 fields, so the complete monitor input is data_not_equivalent
input_file_gate: contained regular relative JSON; file and directory symlinks/reparse points rejected with identity checked before and after open
output_delivery: all input rows are processed; at most 128 result rows are inline and larger results declare summary_with_dataset_refs; sandbox stdout limit is 64 KiB
enablement_gate: initially disabled; enable or rollback-to-enabled only with a persisted passed macOS wind_excel receipt bound to slug, immutable version and calculate.py SHA-256
